Here's what I did:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: checkout-api was on v2.3.1 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), failing health checks with an ~18% error rate. The deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the unhealthy release; v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 across all production regions — the rollback completed successfully.

3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) titled "checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0," describing the failure and the rollback action. The on-call engineer has been paged.

Optional follow-up: verify the service reports healthy on v2.3.0 in the next health check cycle, and investigate what broke in v2.3.1 before attempting a redeploy. Let me know if you'd like me to do either.
